WITH vendedores AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seller_id,
        SUM(i.price) AS ingresos,
        AVG(r.review_score) AS calificacion,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.entrega_con_retraso = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_retrasos
    FROM 
        order_items i
    JOIN 
        vw_entregas_retrasos e ON i.order_id = e.order_id
    JOIN 
        order_reviews r ON i.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE 
        i.seller_id IN (
            SELECT seller_id 
            FROM order_items 
            GROUP BY seller_id 
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 30
        )
    GROUP BY 
        i.seller_id
),
vendedores_ordenados AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        ingresos,
        calificacion,
        pct_retrasos,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS rank_ingresos,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_retrasos DESC) AS rank_retrasos
    FROM 
        vendedores
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_vendedores,
    SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_totales
FROM 
    vendedores_ordenados
WHERE 
    rank_ingresos <= CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.25) 
    AND (calificacion < 3.5 OR rank_retrasos <= CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.15))
